contexts.text: If the Natural conquers... he comes, in the other life, into the unrest and torment of Hell.
For all unrest is from evil and falsity; and all peace from good and truth. AC 3696:2.
To appease the unrest of the lower mind with hope. Signified, Explained. AC 4783.
Otherwise (the Angels) are in a state of unrest...
(Those of the province of the infundibulum) are restless.
Not anything of the love of the world, and consequently not anything of unrest, etc.
Cupidities from (these loves) are what... at last cause the man to make rest consist in unrest...
When he is in this inundation... he thinks restlessly.
For before man has been regenerated ho is in intranquillity, and unrest. Explained.
